description: Main FastAPI application module for backend API of note-keeper. Defines API endpoints for user registration, authentication, and CRUD operations on notes, including middleware setup and startup event handling.

methods.name: on_startup()
methods.description: Creates database tables on startup if they don't exist.

methods.name: login_for_access_token(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(dependencies.get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user and returns JWT token.

methods.name: create_note( note: schemas.NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(dependencies.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(dependencies.get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new note for the authenticated user.

methods.name: read_notes( db: Session = Depends(dependencies.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(dependencies.get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves all notes belonging to the current user.

methods.name: read_note( note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(dependencies.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(dependencies.get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID for the current user.

methods.name: update_note( note_id: int, note_update: schemas.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(dependencies.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(dependencies.get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates content or title of a note.

methods.name: delete_note( note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(dependencies.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(dependencies.get_current_user), )
methods.description: Deletes a note if owned by the user.
